name: sol-advisor
description: Codex orchestration: Sol inherits the user's current reasoning effort for planning and review; Google Antigravity CLI (Gemini 3.8 Flash High) implements.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and review with Sol at the user's current effort; implement solely with Antigravity CLI.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-5.6 Sol in the primary session for architecture, planning, parent verification, and acceptance while inheriting the user's current reasoning effort instead of pinning a tier. All implementation is performed exclusively by the locally installed Google Antigravity CLI using Gemini 3.8 Flash High (effort high, accept-edits mode). After implementation, parent Sol directly inspects working-tree diffs and reruns verification, followed by a mandatory fresh read-only GPT-5.6 Sol review using inherited effort and returning ship, fix-first, or rethink. Fixes route back to Antigravity with zero fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to plan this feature, implement it with Antigravity, and verify with Sol review.
